name: Unconfirmed Transfers
query:
SELECT
  se.name AS "Stock Entry:Link/Stock Entry:200",
  se.posting_date AS "Date:Date:110",
  st.name AS "Team:Link/Service Team:160",
  COUNT(DISTINCT sed.name) AS "Items Count:Int:110",
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), se.posting_date) AS "Days Pending:Int:120"
FROM `tabStock Entry` se
JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sed ON sed.parent = se.name
JOIN `tabService Team` st ON st.team_warehouse = sed.t_warehouse
WHERE se.docstatus = 1
  AND se.confirmation_status = 'Pending Confirmation'
  AND (%(service_team)s = '' OR st.name = %(service_team)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s = '' OR se.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s = '' OR se.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
GROUP BY se.name, se.posting_date, st.name
ORDER BY se.posting_date ASC
